objective: Implement the oracle-approved run/generation-bound nonblocking fence and exact-peer G3 transport submission protocol, closing all findings from the last fresh review.
must_implement: ReviewAdmissionFence state includes a never-reset monotonic generation, binding_nonce, exact run identity/incarnation, CLOSED/OPEN mode, and reason. Every close invalidates earlier open tokens; open is compare-and-swap on the originally captured token and binding.

Fence operations perform only short state comparisons/updates. Review/coordinator locks cover only ticket validation, permit/in-flight registration, and state commit. No action, bridge probe/request/write, journal/repository I/O, mirror publication, or ACK wait occurs while holding admission/coordinator/fence locks.

Pause immediately closes the fence and can issue exact-bound manager abort/pause without waiting for an in-flight automatic action or mirror publication. An already admitted action is in-flight; all admissions linearized after close are held.

Admission requires ticket run/incarnation == SerializedReviewAdmission active run/incarnation == fence bound run/incarnation and a current open permit token. bind_run(B) cannot authorize A; A-to-B-to-A and same identity/new incarnation remain distinct.
Cancellation/repository errors and failure compensation apply only through close_if_binding(captured binding_nonce/token), never close globally before revalidating the captured run.

Extend G3BridgeServer.request/TaskMailbox delivery with optional expected peer identity and authority token validation at the real submission boundary: selected live write_lock acquired, then bridge condition checks current live, exact sessionId/generation, peer pair when required, and current authority token immediately before pending registration. Bound mismatch sends zero bytes, creates no replacement retry/reselection, and returns/raises a fail-closed result.

Use bound G3 requests for pause, resume, compensation pause, and actual automatic OMP delivery. Keep arbitrary callback support only as clearly local admission; add/migrate a concrete bound automatic delivery adapter so exact-peer claims are enforced by the transport rather than a pre-probe.

A stale resume waiting on write_lock cannot send after a newer pause close; a peer replacement cannot receive bytes intended for the old binding. Preserve stop-event correlation, durability, no replay, manual TUI independence, and CW15 boundary.
required_regressions: Resume stopped before open, then newer pause close: stale open fails and no admission occurs.
Long in-flight action/ACK: pause fence and manager abort request progress before action release; later admission is held.
A ticket with B fence, A-B-A binding nonce, and same identity/new incarnation are rejected.
A cancellation/error lookup delayed across B bind cannot change B fence/status.
Peer switch while request waits for write_lock sends no bytes to replacement; pending-registration-then-switch never retries replacement.
Resume waiting for write_lock is overtaken by pause and rejected at authority-token submission check.
Late deferred/unknown completion after pause/rebind never reactivates or replays the old ticket/message.
Repeat pause/resume/bind/action/status/cancellation stress retains abort responsibility and has no deadlock.
verification: Run focused deterministic tests repeatedly, all pause/atomic-admission/bridge/workflow/G3 tests, actual OMP 18.2.10 live pause probe, relevant full regressions, and graphify update .
constraints: Do not edit approved contracts, workflow evidence, tickets, PLAN, or ledger.
Apply source/test edits only with apply_patch; preserve unrelated changes; no destructive git, uv, local .venv, commit, publish, or deploy.
report: bound transport API and migrated paths
